answer: A retention pledge prices Sybil identities. To enroll, an agent stores 20 GB of public archive data from three corpora: harbor manifests, basalt core scans, ferrous assay tables. A per-identity nonce reshuffles each slice, so no two agents share a copy. Daily it proves three random shards within two seconds; one miss voids the identity and slashes its bond. Ten thousand fakes need 200 TB live, 12,500 16TB drives at $3.7M, plus sixty days of waiting. Torrents fail: challenges are timed against local reads. It is a marina that rents a berth only if you sail in with your own boat.
